entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (thumb) is now in a smaller splint, and the Bucs will see if he can progress to gripping the football next week, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams (hamstring) has made tangible progress in his recovery from a Grade 2 hamstring strain sustained in the Week 2 loss to the Vikings, Dan Wiederer of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Camden Brown
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Carsen Ryan
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (toe) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Falcons, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Hollins (calf) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman is expected to miss multiple weeks after aggravating his foot injury, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports Thursday.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: Wallace (knee) didn't practice Thursday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: Thornton is slated to undergo surgery later this week to address the dislocated left ankle he sustained in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders and is facing an expected recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: Mariota (knee) will not be placed on injured reserve, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant (ankle) isn't participating in Thursday's practice, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

entries.name: Alvin Kamara
entries.summary: Kamara (back) practiced in a limited fashion Thursday.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Ashton Jeanty
entries.summary: Jeanty (ankle/foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, with Raiders coach Klint Kubiak saying Friday that the running back will "do his best to go,"Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official site reports.

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: Brown recorded one carry for a loss of five yards while also adding 130 kickoff-return yards and a two-yard punt return during Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Falcons.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) did not participate at the Chargers' practice Thursday.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) will practice in some capacity Friday but is still considered unlikely to play in Sunday's game against the Bengals, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Cam Skattebo
entries.summary: Skattebo (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice Thursday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: CeeDee Lamb
entries.summary: Lamb is believed to be dealing with a "quad bruise" that is "not considered to be serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar (forearm) remained limited in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) remained limited at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell (knee) was limited in Wednesday's practice, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (ankle) didn't practice Thursday.

entries.name: Chris Manhertz
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Chris Olave
entries.summary: Olave (rest/foot) appeared to be moving well during the part of Friday's practice open to the media, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.

entries.name: Cody White
entries.summary: White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (shoulder/knee) was limited in Thursday's practice, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: D'Andre Swift
entries.summary: Swift (hip/knee) returned to practice on a limited basis Thursday, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was limited at practice Thursday.

entries.name: David Martin-Robinson
entries.summary: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) is doing rehab work on a side field at Friday's practice, EJ Smith of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) was not participating during the media viewing period of Thursday's practice,  Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Head coach Nick Sirianni anticipates that Wicks (hamstring) "will be out there" at Friday's practice, according to the Eagles' official X account.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani (ribs) remained limited in Thursday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Gunnar Helm
entries.summary: Helm was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice due to a knee injury.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) did not practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Isaiah Likely
entries.summary: Likely (knee/groin) practiced on a limited basis Thursday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
entries.summary: Chase remains in concussion protocol and will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Charlie Goldsmith reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was a limited practice participant Thursday.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: The Panthers are hopeful that Coker (quadriceps) will be ready to return to action following their Week 5 bye, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: Nailor (concussion) isn't practicing Thursday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (foot) showed up as a limited participant at Thursday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Love (ankle) is "trending in the right direction" ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Addison (hamstring) was at Friday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Justin Jefferson
entries.summary: Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) were at practice Friday, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: Joly (concussion) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Keenan Allen
entries.summary: Allen (groin) was limited in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (foot) didn't practice Thursday.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Nabers (knee) will "be ready to play Sunday" at Washington, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (ribs) didn't practice Thursday, but he was able to run on a side field during the open portion of the session, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

entries.name: Noah Fant
entries.summary: Fant (abdomen) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Quentin Johnston
entries.summary: Johnston (chest) was a limited participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Rachaad White
entries.summary: Head coach Dan Quinn said Friday that White (shoulder) will play Sunday against the Giants, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
entries.summary: Stevenson (knee) said Friday that he's "ready to go", while Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said the running back "is not out as of yet" for Sunday's game against Las Vegas, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (hamstring) wasn't spotted at Friday's practice, EJ Smith reports.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: Diggs (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Giants, Tashan Reed reports after Commanders coach Dan Quinn provided injury updates Friday.

entries.name: Tee Higgins
entries.summary: Higgins (groin/neck) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Head coach Dan Quinn said McLaurin (hamstring) looked good in his return to practice Friday, but his status remains in question for Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (foot) was limited in practice Thursday.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) was seen in the locker room Wednesday without a noticeable limp, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ben Yurosek
entries.summary: Yurosek (undisclosed) practiced Wednesday.

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: The Giants placed Berrios (foot) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: Gabriel (back) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) was a full participant at practice Wednesday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: The Ravens placed Smythe (Achilles) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Long (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Lane (wrist) is "doing really well" and "has put himself in a great position to be ready to roll when the time permits."

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Lane (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols (quadriceps) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) was a limited participant Wednesday after the Packers opened his 21-day practice window.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is expected to be ready to return after his four-game stint on injured reserve, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Tim Patrick
entries.summary: The Jets designated Patrick (groin) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, John Pullano of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
